categories.label: Cats
categories.description: Graceful, curious companions with a wide range of personalities.

breeds.name: Persian
breeds.description: Persians are calm, gentle cats known for their long, luxurious coats and sweet expressions. They thrive in quiet indoor environments and love being pampered.
funFacts: Persians are one of the oldest known cat breeds.
Their flat faces and plush coats make them popular show cats.

breeds.name: Siamese
breeds.description: Siamese cats are vocal, social, and highly intelligent, often forming strong bonds with their owners and following them around the house.
funFacts: Siamese cats are known for striking blue eyes.
They often use loud vocalizations to communicate.

breeds.name: Maine Coon
breeds.description: Maine Coons are one of the largest domestic cat breeds with friendly personalities and a playful, dog-like nature.
funFacts: Maine Coons have tufted ears and bushy tails.
They are often called gentle giants.

breeds.name: Bengal
breeds.description: Bengal cats have an exotic spotted coat and an adventurous personality. They love to climb, explore, and stay mentally stimulated.
funFacts: Bengals are known for leopard-like markings.
Many Bengals enjoy playing with water.

breeds.name: Ragdoll
breeds.description: Ragdolls are gentle, affectionate cats named for their tendency to relax when held. They love human company and have striking blue eyes.
funFacts: Ragdolls often greet owners at the door.
They are popular in families due to calm personalities.

breeds.name: Scottish Fold
breeds.description: Scottish Folds are recognized by folded ears and an owl-like expression. They are calm, adaptable, and devoted companions.
funFacts: The folded ears come from a natural genetic mutation.
Not all kittens in a litter inherit folded ears.

categories.label: Dogs
categories.description: Loyal, trainable breeds ranging from tiny lap dogs to active working companions.

breeds.name: Maltese
breeds.description: The Maltese is a small toy breed known for its silky white coat and affectionate personality. They are playful indoors and thrive on human companionship.
funFacts: The Maltese has been a companion dog for centuries.
Despite size, they are bold and confident.

breeds.name: Labrador Retriever
breeds.description: Labradors are friendly, outgoing, and highly trainable. They are popular as family pets, service dogs, and search-and-rescue partners.
funFacts: Labs are natural swimmers with water-resistant coats.
They are among the most common service dog breeds.

breeds.name: German Shepherd
breeds.description: German Shepherds are loyal and highly intelligent working dogs, commonly used in police, military, and service roles.
funFacts: German Shepherds excel in obedience and scent work.
They form very strong bonds with their families.

breeds.name: Golden Retriever
breeds.description: Golden Retrievers are patient, affectionate, and eager to please. Their gentle temperament makes them excellent family and therapy dogs.
funFacts: Goldens are frequently used as therapy dogs.
They stay puppy-like and playful for years.

breeds.name: French Bulldog
breeds.description: French Bulldogs are small, muscular, and adaptable urban companions with playful personalities and signature bat-like ears.
funFacts: Frenchies are known for expressive faces and ears.
They prefer short play sessions over long runs.

breeds.name: Bulldog
breeds.description: Bulldogs are stocky dogs with distinctive wrinkles. They are calm and gentle despite their tough appearance.
funFacts: Bulldogs are known for their distinctive waddling gait.
They are generally low-maintenance exercise companions.

breeds.name: Poodle
breeds.description: Poodles are highly intelligent and athletic dogs available in Standard, Miniature, and Toy sizes. They are also known for low-shedding coats.
funFacts: Poodles were originally bred as water retrievers.
Their haircut styles started as functional trims.

breeds.name: Beagle
breeds.description: Beagles are merry hounds with excellent scent-tracking ability. They are social dogs that do well with families and other pets.
funFacts: Beagles are often used in scent detection work.
Their noses have over 200 million scent receptors.

breeds.name: Rottweiler
breeds.description: Rottweilers are powerful, confident dogs that are naturally protective and deeply loyal when trained and socialized well.
funFacts: Rottweilers were historically used as cattle-driving dogs.
They are one of the oldest herding-related breeds.

breeds.name: Yorkshire Terrier
breeds.description: Yorkies are tiny, spirited dogs with big personalities and silky coats. They are affectionate and adaptable for city living.
funFacts: Yorkies were originally bred to catch rats in mills.
They often behave like much larger dogs.

breeds.name: Dachshund
breeds.description: Dachshunds have long bodies and short legs, originally bred for badger hunting. They are curious, playful, and determined.
funFacts: The name Dachshund means badger dog in German.
They come in miniature and standard sizes.

categories.label: Rabbits
categories.description: Gentle herbivores that make calm, social pets with unique coat and ear types.

breeds.name: Holland Lop
breeds.description: Holland Lops are small, compact rabbits with lopped ears and affectionate temperaments. They are among the most popular pet rabbit breeds.
funFacts: Holland Lops are known for compact bodies and droopy ears.
They enjoy gentle handling and interactive play.

breeds.name: Flemish Giant
breeds.description: Flemish Giants are one of the largest rabbit breeds and are known as gentle giants because of their docile nature.
funFacts: Flemish Giants can weigh over 15 pounds.
They need roomy enclosures and floor time.

breeds.name: Lionhead
breeds.description: Lionhead rabbits have a woolly mane around their head and are energetic, curious companions that bond well with regular handling.
funFacts: Their lion-like mane is the breed hallmark.
Regular brushing keeps their mane healthy.

breeds.name: Rex Rabbit
breeds.description: Rex Rabbits are famous for plush velvety fur and calm, gentle personalities that make them easy to handle.
funFacts: Rex fur stands upright, creating a velvet feel.
They are often chosen as therapy rabbits.

breeds.name: Angora
breeds.description: Angora rabbits are prized for ultra-soft wool and gentle temperaments, but require frequent grooming to prevent matting.
funFacts: Angora wool is one of the softest natural fibers.
Routine grooming is essential for their health.

breeds.name: Mini Rex
breeds.description: Mini Rex rabbits share the plush velvety coat of standard Rex rabbits in a compact size and are curious indoor companions.
funFacts: Mini Rex coats feel plush due to short upright fur.
They do well in homes with enrichment toys.

categories.label: Birds
categories.description: Bright, social birds known for intelligence, song, and playful personalities.

breeds.name: Budgerigar
breeds.description: Budgies are small parrots that are social, vocal, and beginner-friendly. They thrive with daily interaction and enrichment.
funFacts: Budgies can learn words and sounds.
They are among the world’s most popular pet birds.

breeds.name: Cockatiel
breeds.description: Cockatiels are gentle companion birds with expressive crests and friendly temperaments. Many whistle tunes and mimic household sounds.
funFacts: Cockatiels communicate mood through their crest feathers.
They love shoulder perches and interaction.

breeds.name: Canary
breeds.description: Canaries are prized for bright colors and melodic songs. They are best appreciated as observing companions rather than handling pets.
funFacts: Male canaries are usually the strongest singers.
Canaries were historically used in coal mines for safety alerts.

breeds.name: African Grey Parrot
breeds.description: African Greys are exceptionally intelligent parrots known for advanced mimicry and strong social bonds with caretakers.
funFacts: African Greys are considered among the smartest birds.
They need regular mental stimulation to stay healthy.
